name: gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pnpm-lock.yaml
            desktop/linux/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: desktop/linux
      - run: pnpm docs:api
      - run: pnpm gate
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: sites/umbrella
      - run: pnpm test:provider
        working-directory: sites/umbrella
      - run: pnpm test:integration
        working-directory: sites/umbrella
      - run: pnpm typecheck
        working-directory: sites/umbrella

  # `pnpm gate` type-checks each site's `src/index.ts` and `src/lib/**`, but nothing in it
  # runs a site's own production Next build, so a bundling or trace regression would first
  # surface on the Vercel builder. Each site is its own install root (ADR 0018); its
  # `postbuild` runs the same Vercel packaging check the deployment runs.
  sites-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        site: [umbrella, catalog-game, catalog-web]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pnpm-lock.yaml
            sites/${{ matrix.site }}/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: sites/${{ matrix.site }}
      - run: pnpm typecheck
        working-directory: sites/${{ matrix.site }}
      - run: pnpm build
        working-directory: sites/${{ matrix.site }}

  # Isolated local build coverage only: no deployment, secrets or shared imports.
  kids-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: sites/kids/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: sites/kids
      - run: pnpm typecheck
        working-directory: sites/kids
      - run: pnpm build
        working-directory: sites/kids

name: engine-sdk

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  engine-sdk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          node-version: 24

      # The builder and the publish-readiness checker are dependency-free plain ESM,
      # so no install step is needed for either.
      - name: Check publish readiness
        run: node scripts/check-publish-ready.mjs

      - name: Build the public engine SDK archive
        run: node scripts/build-engine-sdk.mjs --out dist-sdk

      # Independent verification: a third-party reader must accept the archive, and
      # the published checksum must match the bytes we are about to upload.
      - name: Verify archive integrity and checksum
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unzip -t dist-sdk/*.zip
          ( cd dist-sdk && sha256sum -c ./*.zip.sha256 )
          cat dist-sdk/sdk-manifest.json

      # Determinism is the property the published checksum rests on, so prove it in
      # CI rather than trusting it.
      - name: Prove the build is deterministic
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/build-engine-sdk.mjs --out dist-sdk-again
          diff <(sha256sum dist-sdk/*.zip | cut -d' ' -f1) \
               <(sha256sum dist-sdk-again/*.zip | cut -d' ' -f1)

      - name: Refuse a Kids file in the archive
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if unzip -l dist-sdk/*.zip | grep -i kids; then
            echo "Kids content reached the public SDK archive — isolation violation" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          name: sceneaxi-engine-sdk
          path: |
            dist-sdk/*.zip
            dist-sdk/*.zip.sha256
            dist-sdk/sdk-manifest.json
          if-no-files-found: error

name: desktop-linux

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  desktop-linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      # No explicit pnpm version: the root `packageManager` field pins it, exactly
      # as the gate workflow resolves it.
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      # The tier links workspace packages by path, so the hermetic root install
      # must exist first; both installs are frozen-lockfile.
      - name: Install the hermetic root
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install the desktop tier
        working-directory: desktop/linux
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # `pnpm dist` runs esbuild, which strips types without checking them, and the
      # root build covers only this tier's `src/index.ts` and `src/lib/**`. This is the
      # only place the main-process and renderer entry points are type-checked.
      - name: Type-check the desktop tier
        working-directory: desktop/linux
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Build the runtime and package AppImage + deb
        working-directory: desktop/linux
        run: pnpm dist

      # The checksums travel with the artifacts; verify them before uploading the
      # same bytes, exactly as a downloader will.
      - name: Verify checksums
        working-directory: desktop/linux/release
        run: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

      # The packaged binary must prove the engine paths are real: kernel digests
      # that move, the shared authoring round trip, and a real presentation frame.
      # SwiftShader under Xvfb keeps WebGL a real rasterizer on a GPU-less runner.
      - name: Smoke the packaged app
        working-directory: desktop/linux
        run: xvfb-run -a pnpm smoke --packaged

      # A workflow artifact, not a GitHub Release: no release authority is claimed
      # (the same posture as the engine SDK, ADR 0019). The retention window is
      # declared here rather than inherited from a settings page, because
      # `docs/desktop-linux.md` and the umbrella `/engine` record state the date the
      # download expires and nothing at runtime can observe that expiry.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          name: sceneaxi-desktop-linux
          path: |
            desktop/linux/release/*.AppImage
            desktop/linux/release/*.deb
            desktop/linux/release/SHA256SUMS
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

name: desktop-macos

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_candidate:
        description: >-
          Build, sign, and notarize a release candidate on a macOS runner. Leave false
          to reproduce the pull-request verification job, which is what recovers a
          missing or cancelled required check.
        type: boolean
        default: false
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  desktop-macos:
    # Only the release-candidate steps below need a macOS host, and macOS minutes bill
    # at 10x. Type-check, staging build, and the configuration smoke are all
    # platform-independent — the missing-input refusals are proven on Linux by the
    # repository gate — so every run except an explicit release candidate uses ubuntu.
    runs-on: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_candidate == true && 'macos-latest' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pnpm-lock.yaml
            desktop/linux/pnpm-lock.yaml
            desktop/macos/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install the hermetic root
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install the existing desktop application
        working-directory: desktop/linux
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install the macOS packaging root
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type-check the macOS bootstrap and packaging scripts
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Stage the existing desktop runtime with updates disabled
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Smoke configuration and missing release inputs
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm smoke

      # Only an operator-dispatched run that explicitly asks for a release candidate
      # reaches release packaging; a default dispatch stops above, exactly like a pull
      # request. Empty secrets or a missing URL are passed as empty strings and
      # `pnpm dist` refuses by name, so absent credentials still fail closed here.
      - name: Build, sign, notarize, and verify the release candidate
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_candidate == true
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm dist
        env:
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.MAC_CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAC_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
          SCENEAXI_MACOS_RELEASE_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.SCENEAXI_MACOS_RELEASE_BASE_URL }}

      - name: Smoke the signed packaged application
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_candidate == true
        working-directory: desktop/macos
        run: pnpm smoke --packaged

      # This is a verified workflow artifact, not a public release or an update
      # upload. Download IA remains unchanged until a durable release is recorded.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4 — official upstream commit verified by git ls-remote
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_candidate == true
        with:
          name: sceneaxi-desktop-macos
          path: |
            desktop/macos/release/*.dmg
            desktop/macos/release/*.zip
            desktop/macos/release/SHA256SUMS
            desktop/macos/release/latest-mac.yml
            desktop/macos/release/desktop-macos-release.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
